rationale.edition: Every changed path lives under web/src/ (web/src/lib/overlay/Drawer/ and web/src/plugins/traces/), which are open-source frontend locations; none fall under enterprise-owned directories such as o2_enterprise/ or enterprise/. No enterprise-gated keywords (SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, cipher, logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: there is no explicit opt-out (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty, no tests-added label in context), and the change is not docs/CI-only — it modifies two live Vue components (ODrawer.vue and ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.vue) that a user exercises in the Traces UI.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.vue now renders its drawer with modal=false, so the service-graph page behind the side panel stays interactive instead of being blocked — a changed interaction a user can observe. ODrawer.vue also switches auto-focus to preventScroll, a subtle focus-behaviour change best sanity-checked via the same flow.
rationale.area: The bulk of the behavioural change is in web/src/plugins/traces/ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.vue, and the sibling Playwright specs for this surface live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/ (e.g. service-graph.spec.js), so Traces is the correct area.
rationale.group: The Traces testfolder shard already owns service-graph.spec.js (the Service Graph UI spec), so a new service-graph-side-panel.spec.js belongs in the same Traces shard to run alongside the existing graph coverage.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff — the only test files changed are Vitest/unit specs under web/src (ODrawer.spec.ts, ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.spec.ts, ServiceGraphSidePanel.spec.ts, ServicesCatalog.spec.ts), which are dev test-maintenance and not E2E coverage.
